routes.name: Panel
routes.role: The closest continuation of your current identity.
routes.idea: Separate interface panels form a Z beside an open rectangular O. A blue cursor gives the system one point of focus.
routes.color: Neutral linework carries the symbol. White carries the name. Blue belongs only to the cursor.
routes.motion: Move the cursor by one grid step on hover or focus, then return it. Keep the outlined panels stationary.
routes.small: Below 48px, use the heavier single-color symbol. Do not use the outlined version below 48px or the single-color symbol below 32px.
routes.alt: Four outlined rectangles step through a Z beside a rectangular O with a blue cursor square.

routes.name: Fold
routes.role: The strongest silhouette for a compact header mark.
routes.idea: A broad Z folds around an angular O counter. One small blue plane identifies the terminal without weakening the silhouette.
routes.color: White defines the mass of the monogram. One rectangular plane carries blue; no extra colored faces are added.
routes.motion: Shift the blue terminal by at most one quarter of its width on hover or focus. Keep the main silhouette fixed.
routes.small: Use the single-color silhouette below 32px. Its open counter and broad diagonal remain the defining elements; stop at 24px.
routes.alt: A filled angular Z wraps a cut-out O counter, with a small blue rectangular terminal.

routes.name: Baseline
routes.role: The most direct expression of your name.
routes.idea: Lowercase lettering sits on two offset lines. The compact symbol repeats those baselines as two rails and a square terminal.
routes.color: White gives the name priority. Neutral rails support it. Blue marks the endpoint of the reading line.
routes.motion: Reveal the second rail and terminal together in a short opacity transition. Keep the lettering still.
routes.small: Use the rails-only symbol below the wordmark minimum. For a single-color application, retain both rails and the terminal square; stop at 24px.
routes.alt: Two offset horizontal rails end in a blue square, echoing the two lines of the lowercase wordmark.
